issues.description: Method signature mismatch for getTotalNumberOfStudents: the problem statement (text and UML) declares a no-argument method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (problem_statement.md lines 40-41 and UML line 70), but the solution implementation defines getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75). This parameter difference changes the public API students must implement and will confuse students (they will implement a no-arg method as instructed) and may cause automated checks to fail or be misaligned with the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution API match the problem statement and UML: change the solution method to public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() (no parameters) and have it return the total number of students (inscribed + guest). If conditional behavior (include/exclude guests) is desired, either add an overloaded method public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) in addition to the no-arg method, or update the problem statement and the UML to explicitly document the boolean parameter and its semantics so all artifacts (problem statement, template, tests, and solution) use the same signature.
